articles.headline: MSME STATE CONFERENCE FOR MANGALURU
articles.blurb: The Karnataka government will host a three-day MSME State Conference in Mangaluru from November 5 to 7 at Hotel Ocean Pearl, with Commerce and Industries Minister M.B. Patil, MSME Development Corporation chair Padmanabha Balakrishna and Bantwal MLA Rajesh Naik among speakers; organisers said entrepreneurs need better access to finance and awareness of government schemes.

articles.headline: TAX CUT ON LIQUOR TO BOOST REVENUE, SAYS EXCISE MINISTER
articles.blurb: After a review chaired by Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, Excise Minister N.S. Boseraju said abolishing the 15% import duty and offering a 30% concession rate on liquor is aimed at boosting state revenue, noting liquor licences have been frozen since 2008.

articles.headline: Price war continues as Prestige, IFB slash prices of kitchen appliances
articles.blurb: Prestige and IFB have cut prices on kitchen appliances amid a continuing consumer durables price war, the brief on the front page reported.

articles.headline: Police raid 5 bars, arrest 2 over IPL betting
articles.blurb: Mangaluru CCB raided five bars including Seafood Pub and Mist Pub, arresting Kiran and Dasaraju and seizing cash, mobile phones and laptops over alleged IPL betting.

articles.headline: NEW MANGALURU–KHOPOLI TRAIN FROM NOV 1
articles.blurb: Southern Railway will extend the Mangaluru Junction–Khopoli service to Mangaluru Central from November 1, the front-page brief said.

articles.headline: GEN Z'S RISE IN LUXURY: REWRITING THE RULES

articles.headline: COUPLE'S DEATH RAISES SUSPICION OF ACID ATTACK
articles.blurb: Dr Arun Mascarenhas and his wife Dr Lavanya were found dead at their Bajpe home after a dispute with labourers; police arrested Santhosh and are investigating whether acid was used.

articles.headline: ₹50 CRORE FRAUD BY FAKE AGENT IN SHANKERPURA
